nodes.label: Midnight Observatory Design Concept
nodes.rationale: Celestial navigation for markets: a private observatory of deep violet night, brass instruments, charted constellations of market data. Scene: an investor opens the site in the evening deciding whom to trust with family wealth — dark, calm, precise.

nodes.label: Color Strategy (Drenched Dark + Light Act + Violet Drench)
nodes.rationale: Drenched dark base + committed light act + one violet drench. Page arc: midnight (hero/ticker) -> porcelain (manifesto/products) -> midnight (journey/trust) -> porcelain (testimonials) -> violet (CTA) -> midnight (footer).

nodes.label: OKLCH Color Tokens (Tailwind v4 @theme)
nodes.rationale: Tokens defined in src/app/globals.css: midnight, midnight-2, violet, violet-bright, lavender, lavender-dim, brass, brass-deep, porcelain, ink, ink-muted, mist. Dark is always violet midnight (never neutral black); brass capped at accent duty (<=10% of surface); lavender-dim keeps >=4.5:1 contrast on midnight.

nodes.label: Typography System (Fraunces + DM Sans)
nodes.rationale: Fraunces (variable: opsz, SOFT, WONK, italic) is the identity face because it matches the original logo wordmark; italic emphasizes exactly one word/phrase per heading. DM Sans for body/UI. Display ceiling clamp 6rem hero-only; letter-spacing floor -0.02em.

nodes.label: Motion System (Expo Ease + Lenis + Intro Gating)
nodes.rationale: Single ease --ease-out-expo cubic-bezier(0.19,1,0.22,1) (exported as EXPO from ui/Reveal); durations 0.2-0.3s micro, 0.8-1.25s reveals; Lenis smooth scroll; preloader gates hero choreography via IntroProvider context (useIntroDone); every animation has a reduced-motion path; marquee via animate-marquee keyframe with -50% translate and duplicated row.

nodes.label: landonorris.com Interaction Language
nodes.rationale: Borrowed patterns: drenched-brand preloader with monogram + counter, masked word reveals, marquee ticker, hover-sweep index rows, sticky scrollytelling, expo ease cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1).

nodes.label: Project-Specific Design Bans
nodes.rationale: No gradient text, backdrop-blur, side accent stripes, uppercase tracked eyebrows, emoji icons, or icon libraries (inline SVG only). Brass never exceeds accent duty on light sections (use brass-deep for text there, for contrast). Never neutral-black backgrounds — dark is always violet midnight.

nodes.label: MarketConstellation (R3F hero canvas)
nodes.rationale: R3F hero canvas rendering a points terrain + brass index line; dynamic-imported with ssr:false.
